hare.definition:
n. swift timid long-eared mammal larger than a rabbit having a divided upper lip and long hind legs; young born furred and with open eyes
v. run quickly, like a hare
hare.translation:

vi. 飞跑

harefoot.definition:
n. A long, narrow foot, carried (that is, produced or
   extending) forward; -- said of dogs.
n. A tree (Ochroma Laqopus) of the West Indies, having the
   stamens united somewhat in the form of a hare's foot.
